name: Waterfowl and Reeds
dimensions: Painting only: 23.4 x 23.5 cm (9 3/16 x 9 1/4 in.); Overall with knobs: 108 x 42.4 cm (42 1/2 x 16 11/16 in.)
summary: This album leaf now mounted as a hanging scroll is attributed to the 13th-century artist Liang Kai, who served for a time in the Southern Song court as a court painter.
